notes: Supersedes v0.1.2-candidates, which is left on disk untouched, as are v0.1.1-candidates and v0.1-candidates. All 178 v0.1.2 records are carried through byte-for-byte, in the same order and with no re-serialisation; 26 new records follow at cv-0180 through cv-0205. Nothing was dropped or edited. The 26 give selection headroom in the four categories that had almost none: ambiguous 6 -> 13, noisy 6 -> 13, version_sensitive 7 -> 13, unanswerable 17 -> 23. source_chunk_ids remain provenance pointers, not gold labels, and are valid only against the recorded corpus snapshot. Generation brief behind prompt_hash df6de014544b2c1c: v0.1.3 headroom brief: 26 new candidates in the four categories that had no selection headroom -- ambiguous 7, noisy 7, version_sensitive 6, unanswerable 6, ids cv-0180 through cv-0205. Ambiguous questions name no venue and apply to two or more, grounded in chunks from different venues that answer differently. Noisy questions each carry a different kind of surface damage -- wrong casing, dropped articles, telegraphic fragments, shouting, non-native phrasing, a run-on with misspellings, a transposed endpoint path -- over a real grounded information need. Version_sensitive questions turn on which version, product line, account mode or environment is meant, with both sides grounded. Unanswerable questions are proven gaps: the concept searched under every spelling the vendor uses, restricted to the target venue and corpus-wide, with the hit counts recorded in notes, and a near miss left in the corpus so a retriever returns something confident and wrong. Venue spread deliberately widened away from binance and uniswap.
